messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up: Acme Corp shows up today from two places — marketplace conversion and an SI intro. We had messy back-and-forth last time. Can we agree a short claim flow? @Rajiv?

Rajiv Nair: Agree we need something lightweight. My suggestion: 1) auto-assign tentative owner based on priority list; 2) partner must post a claim message with one of allowed proofs within 24h to finalize; 3) if conflict remains after 72h, Ops adjudicates.

Owen Patel: What counts as "allowed proof"? We should enumerate so SI partners know. Ideas: signed NDA/intro email thread, calendar invite with SVP-level attendees, marketplace order id, or a Jira ticket linking SI scope.

Lina Gomez: Short list to consume in code: ["marketplace_order_id","signed_engagement_email","first_qualified_meeting_ics","partner_scope_jira","po_or_so"] Also allow an "operator_claim" that RevOps can set when manual review completed.

Maya Chen: Good. Also need region and territory rules - SI partner A may own EMEA but not NA. If both touch same account but different regions, split ownership by territory.

Rajiv Nair: Add rule: if account already has an active AE owner in CRM, AE gets precedence unless SI provides an explicit co-sell agreement. Prevents surprise takeovers.

Owen Patel: For high-risk stalls (ACV > $500k), auto-create a Slack thread in #partnerships-escalations and ping deal execs after 7 days. Include a brief template we can send: 

```
Subject: SI Claim for Acme Corp - action required
Body: SI Acme Solutions claims co-sell for Acme Corp. Proof attached: signed engagement email dated 2026-03-18. Please confirm ownership within 48 hours or RevOps will adjudicate.
```

Lina Gomez: I can wire this into the webhook. Plan: webhook evaluates lead_source_detail, partner_org_id, marketplace_id, crm_owner_id, acv_amount, region. It then emits a recommended_owner and claim_deadline. If partner posts allowed proof to the claim thread before deadline, ownership finalizes.

partner-bot: Created ticket PART-5882 "SI claim proof UI and webhook" and attached this thread.

revops-bot: Note: will add a small audit field "ownership_history" in CRM to log all claim events for compliance.

Maya Chen: Quick decision on default priority? I vote: marketplace > si-intro > direct-sdr, but with explicit SI claim window of 24h. If SI provides proof in that window, SI wins. If both provide proof simultaneously, escalate.

Rajiv Nair: +1 to that ordering. Also recommend a simple email template for partners to submit proof so we have consistent headers: subject must include "SI CLAIM" + account name + partner org id.

Lina Gomez: Draft JSON policy for engineers: 

```
{"priority": ["marketplace","si-intro","direct-sdr"], "si_claim_window_hours": 24, "conflict_escalation_hours": 72, "high_acv_threshold": 500000, "escalation_channel": "partnerships-escalations", "allowed_proofs": ["marketplace_order_id","signed_engagement_email","first_qualified_meeting_ics","partner_scope_jira","po_or_so"]}
```

Maya Chen: Action items: Lina  implement webhook skeleton + Confluence playbook; Rajiv  draft partner email template and region carve rules; Owen  add exec-esc SLA language for >$500k; I'll coordinate RevOps for CRM audit fields. ETA Tue morning.

Owen Patel: I'll also add a fallback: if partner proof references an order id, RevOps will verify within 48h and can mark operator_claim true to finalize if verification passes.

Maya Chen: Thanks. This should make claims much clearer and reduce partner friction. :white_check_mark:
